_comment: Microsoft Azure DevOps MCP Server (Official) — task management, repos, pipelines
_setup: claude mcp add azure-devops -- npx -y @azure-devops/mcp YOUR_ORG_NAME
Option B — claude_desktop_config.json (paste the block below under 'mcpServers'):
Replace YOUR_ORG_NAME with your Azure DevOps organization name
interactive (default) — browser login, best for local dev
pat — Personal Access Token via PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var
_capabilities: Boards: work items, iterations, areas, queries, board settings
Repos: pull requests, branches, commits, diffs, file content
Test Plans: test cases, suites, results

azure-devops._comment_auth: Default: interactive browser login. For PAT auth, add: '--authentication', 'pat'
azure-devops._comment_pat: If using PAT auth, set env var: PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=your_pat_here
